title: Canto 2: The Cosmic Manifestation - Title, Artist and Source Pictures Canto 2
content:
Title, Artist and Source Pictures Canto 2​

2.1

Title: 'Universal Form’

Artist: Johannes Ptok (Aka Janmanalaya)

Source: Consciousart gallery & Ptok.se

2.2

Title: 'Lakṣmīdevī meditating on Nārāyaṇa’

Artist: Johannes Ptok (Aka Janmanalaya)

Source: Consciousart gallery & Ptok.se

2.3

Title: The still life of bhakti is titled: “Still”

Artist: Vlad Holst, used with permission

Source: Ten Dreams.org

2.4

Title: 'Keśava’

Artist: Johannes Ptok (Aka Janmanalaya)

Source: Consciousart gallery & Ptok.se

2.5

Title: The picture is a popular Hindu vintage representation of Lord Brahmā

Artist: Unknown

Source: Internet

2.6

Title: Trimurti as the Universal Form identified with nature is a vintage Hindu image

& ‘A Coming Storm’

Artist: By Anand Aadhar digitally positioned in an American landscape painting titled:

'A Coming Storm', by Sanford Gifford, American, 1823-1880.

Source: Philadelphia Museum of Art

2.7

Title: The two images are the left and right side of a water color painting titled: ‘Dasavatar’.

Artist: Andhra Pradesh, 19th century, India

Source: Victoria and Albert Museum

2.8

Title: Parīkṣit and the sages before Śukadeva Gosvāmī

Artist: Kishangarh painting of the Rajasthani school, India, ± 17th century.

Source: The Hare Kṛṣṇas, harekrsna.com

2.9

Title: The picture of the demigods worshiping the Lord of Vaikuṇṭha is titled: ‘Śiva, Indra, Brahmā and the Earth in the Form of a Cow pray to Nārāyaṇa, requesting Him to relieve the earth’s burden’.

Artist: Kailash Raj

Source: exoticindiaart.com, used with permission.

2.10

Title: The picture is showing an episode from the Bhāgavata Purāṇa.

‘Kṛṣṇa in the form of a young cowherd plays his flute to entice the cowgirls’.

17th century kalapustaka, a lavishly illustrated manuscript from Nepal.

Source: Cambridge University site on sacred scripts.
